# API design

- API-004 (must): Every HTTP endpoint that lists a collection pages it in the data store, in a deterministic order, with limit (default 25, at most 100) and offset (at most 10,000) query parameters, and answers an object with the page's items and a nextLink to the next page, null on the last page or the last one the offset cap allows.
- API-011 (should): For an endpoint that returns a collection, use limit and offset query parameters with meaningful defaults, such as limit=25 and offset=0, and consider an upper limit on the number of items returned. Apply pagination in the data store, not after loading the entire collection, with a deterministic sort order; include a next-page link or continuation token in the response, omitted or null on the last page; and for a large or frequently changing collection, evaluate cursor-based pagination.
